'''Kaju Barfi''' is an Indian sweet made with [[Cookbook:Cashew|cashew nuts]].

== Ingredients ==

* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* [[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]]
* [[Cookbook:Ghee|Ghee]]
* [[Cookbook:Cashew|Cashew]] nut powder
* Edible silver leaf/foil

== Procedure ==
   
# Combine the sugar and water in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Add saffron to the solution and cook it till it forms a [[Cookbook:Syrup|syrup]] of [[Cookbook:Cooking Sugar#Thread Test|three-thread]] consistency.
# Melt the ghee, and mix this into the syrup.
# Add cashew nut powder and mix it thoroughly.
# Allow it to cool slightly.
# [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] the mixture well, and roll it into a rectangle 0.5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] thick.
# Lay the silver foil over the rectangle. Cut it into diamond shapes of approximately 1.5-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] length.
